_meta.policy: The union of `focus` + `keepers` is the INDEXABLE tool set: these appear in sitemap-app.xml and get no robots meta. Every other tool stays fully live for users, but is dropped from the sitemap and gets <meta name="googlebot" content="noindex"> in its prerendered HTML (googlebot, not robots — scoped on 2026-08-02 so Bing keeps the pages). To re-release a tool (drip, once the focus set is indexed): add its ID to `focus` and rebuild — AND check its guides are on guides/keep-list.json. Adding the ID alone brings the tool back indexable with NO Related-guides block and NO category-hub link, because prerender's loadGuidesByTool() filters to the keep-list (correctly: those blocks must never point Google at URLs that 301 to a hub anchor). Found on DateNight 2026-08-08: one guide references it, practical/date-ideas-for-introverts, and it is not on the keep-list, so the tool page carries zero guide or hub links. Harmless while noindexed; a self-inflicted orphan the moment it is promoted. Eight tools are currently in this state (2026-08-08): CrashPredictor, DateNight, GratitudeDebtClearer, LeverageLogic, MeetingHijackPreventer, PreMortem, SubscriptionSlayer, TaskAvalancheBreaker — every one of their guides is off the keep-list. Check this list before promoting any of them. Consumed by scripts/generate-sitemap.js, scripts/prerender.js, and scripts/check-sitemap-urls.js (which enforces sitemap-vs-noindex consistency).
_meta.focus_criteria: The 18 bets: most unique, deepest, or targeting terms people actually search for. Chosen 2026-07-14.
_meta.keepers_criteria: Already indexed per the GSC 6/25 export (minus the two that are also in focus) — never throw away a win. ContrastReport/DebateMe map to their renamed IDs WhichLife/ArgueSmarter.
